Check their operation and inspect the assembled bicycle for visible loose or damaged parts.</step></Location></root>
processNotes: All tooling, processes and times are inferred demo estimates.
The frame and fork, wheels and other manufactured subassemblies are received prepared unless their actual nested BOM is discussed below.
The subassembly routing is inferred. The supplied historical record places product 779 at Final Assembly, location 60; it is evidence, not an engineering specification.
The pedal quantity is preserved as 1 EA from the BOM; it is not interpreted as a pair.
variantNotes: The representative is Silver, 38 and uses 1 EA frame FR-M94S-38, product 748.
Silver, 42 uses 1 EA frame FR-M94S-42, product 739; Silver, 46 uses 1 EA frame FR-M94S-46, product 742.
Black, 38 uses 1 EA frame FR-M94B-38, product 747; Black, 42 uses 1 EA frame FR-M94B-42, product 743; Black, 46 uses 1 EA frame FR-M94B-46, product 746.

The supplied direct BOMs show the same other components and quantities for all six variants, including front wheel 816 and rear wheel 824. The representative frame BOM specifies 8 OZ of silver paint; paint details for the other frames are not supplied.

revisions.description: Initial controlled issue for product introduction; established the component list and work-center sequence.
Standardized work-center hand-off notes and separated preparation time from hands-on labor.
Aligned component count checks with the bill of materials and removed a duplicate sign-off box.
Released the illustrated workstation edition: Major bicycle assembly orientation. Matched numbered component legends to the operating steps and adopted the Manufacturing Hub document layout.

100201.title: Major bicycle assembly orientation
guidance: Support 1 EA HL Mountain Frame - Silver, 38 (Product Number FR-M94S-38) in an assumed bicycle assembly stand. The frame BOM includes the fork. Use illustration 100201 to orient the major assemblies.
Fit 1 EA ML Headset (Product Number HS-2451) at the frame and fork, then fit 1 EA HL Mountain Handlebars (Product Number HB-M918). Check that steering moves freely.
Fit 1 EA HL Mountain Seat Assembly (Product Number SA-M687) to the frame and check that it is secure.
Fit 1 EA ML Mountain Front Wheel (Product Number FW-M762) at the front and 1 EA ML Mountain Rear Wheel (Product Number RW-M762) at the rear. Check seating and free rotation.
Fit 1 EA ML Bottom Bracket (Product Number BB-8107), 1 EA ML Crankset (Product Number CS-6583) and the BOM quantity of 1 EA ML Mountain Pedal (Product Number PD-M340). Check movement by hand.
